***

Structurify is a configuration mod that makes configuring everything related to structures very easy and accessible, eliminating the hassle of creating multiple datapacks. You can download the mod from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/structurify) or [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/structurify).
